 ORDER

This is the fifth application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to Crime No.615/2023 registered at police Station Kotwali Distt. Datia, for the offence punishable under Sections 376(GH), 323, 294, 506, 120-B of IPC and Sections 5(g), 6, 16, 17 of the POCSO Act.

2. Allegation against the applicant is that he along with co-accused committed rape with prosecutrix No.1 and prosecutrix No.2.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
He is in custody since 03.09.2023.
It is further submitted that co-accused Kishan Singh Parmar has already been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 22.3.2025 passed in M.Cr.C. No.10468 of 2025.
The case of present applicant is similar to that of co- NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:8222 2 MCRC-14725-2025 accused Kishan Singh,
Hence, he seeks parity with the aforesaid co-accused.
As regards the criminal history, one more case has been registered against the applicant but he has been falsely implicated in that case.
He is ready and willing to abide by any condition which may be imposed by the Court.
Conclusion of trial will take time.
Hence, counsel for applicant prays that present applicant may be enlarged on bail.
4. Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the bail application on the ground of criminal history of applicant and prayed to dismiss the bail application.

However, he fairly conceded the fact Vikram Gurjar @ Vikky vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95728453/

sentences.text:
5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6.

Having considered the rival submissions and attending facts and circumstances of the case and that aforesaid similarly situated co-accused has already been released on bail, this Court is of the view that applicant may be granted bail.
Hence, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application is allowed with stringent condition.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One lakh Only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
In case, if he is found involved in the offence of same nature, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically without further reference to the Bench.

v) The applicant will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial; and vi) The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be; and vii) The applicant shall appear before the concerned police Station once in every fortnight till conclusion of trial.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.
(RAJENDRA KUMAR VANI) JUDGE Ahmad Vikram Gurjar @ Vikky vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95728453/
